name: orchestre
description: Runs a dev plan split into tasks (plans/<name>), phase by phase, with subagents: work on the model chosen for each task when the plan is prepared, verification, evaluation, fixes, merge and progress. Installs itself into a repository when the plan is prepared. Includes a progress mod in the pilot session: banner above the prompt, spinner, /progress (opened at the first run of the session) and /progress demo.
